title: A Grammar of the Classical Arabic Language
text:
About this project
This is a Quarto book that aims to make Howell’s A grammar of the Classical Arabic Language more navigable.
It reuses files and links from Asim Iqbal (جزاه الله خيرًا)’s site: https://revivearabic.blogspot.com/2016/03/grammar-classical-arabic-language-howell-arabicgrammar-pdf.html
It is a work in progress.
